nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group, let $\Phi(G)$ be its Frattini subgroup and let $Z(\Phi(G))$ be the centre of $\Phi(G)$. The property holds when every map $\delta \colon G \to Z(\Phi(G))$ with $\delta(gh) = \delta(g)\, g\, \delta(h)\, g^{-1}$ for all $g, h \in G$ and $\delta(g) = 1$ for all $g \in \Phi(G)$ is a coboundary: there is an $a \in Z(\Phi(G))$ with $\delta(g) = g a g^{-1} a^{-1}$ for all $g \in G$.
nodes.title: Vanishing first cohomology of $G/\Phi(G)$ in $Z(\Phi(G))$

nodes.summary: An element $x$ of a group $G$ lies in the centre $Z(\Phi(G))$ of the Frattini subgroup $\Phi(G)$ when $x \in \Phi(G)$ and $xy = yx$ for every $y \in \Phi(G)$.
nodes.title: Centre of the Frattini subgroup

nodes.summary: There exist a prime $p$ and a finite non-abelian $p$-group $G$ such that, writing $\Phi(G)$ for the Frattini subgroup of $G$ and $Z(\Phi(G))$ for its centre, the first cohomology group $H^1(G/\Phi(G), Z(\Phi(G)))$ for the conjugation action of $G/\Phi(G)$ on $Z(\Phi(G))$ is trivial.
nodes.title: A non-abelian $p$-group with $H^1(G/\Phi(G), Z(\Phi(G))) = 0$ (Kourovka 17.2)

nodes.summary: The statement, a question of P. Schmid recorded by A. Abdollahi, that there exist a prime $p$ and a finite non-abelian $p$-group $G$ such that, writing $\Phi(G)$ for the Frattini subgroup of $G$ and $Z(\Phi(G))$ for its centre, the first cohomology group $H^1(G/\Phi(G), Z(\Phi(G)))$ for the conjugation action of $G/\Phi(G)$ on $Z(\Phi(G))$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 17.2 (a non-abelian $p$-group with trivial $H^1$)
